content:
The new generation of Apple TV 4K is long overdue; it was originally expected to launch last autumn. However, with Siri AI finally ready, all signs point to the new Apple TV 4K making its debut — very possibly at the September 9 event. Here are the latest rumours.

First: Siri Remote upgrade

Although concrete details have not yet leaked, Apple is reportedly set to unveil an updated Siri Remote alongside the new Apple TV 4K.

Code from the macOS 26.7 beta appears to confirm the existence of a new Siri Remote. And prior to this leak, Mark Gurman had already reported that the new hardware might come with an "improved Apple TV remote".

It doesn't look like there will be major changes, but hopefully at least an upgrade to a second-generation ultra-wideband chip to support precision finding.

Second: Siri AI and more Apple Intelligence features

Siri AI is expected to be the main selling point of the new Apple TV and other new home products.

Apple has yet to reveal whether the new assistant will land on the Apple TV 4K or HomePod. But growing evidence suggests that tvOS 27 will come with Siri AI built in, and may only support new hardware.

It is highly likely that other Apple Intelligence features will be added, such as an enhanced search experience.

Third: All-new A-series chip

The current Apple TV runs on the A15 Bionic chip, first launched in 2021. The good news is that the new model will see a significant performance boost.

It will come with a more powerful all-new A-series chip, powerful enough to support AI features.

There are rumours it might be the A17 Pro or A18 chip, but most of those reports predate the Siri AI rollout. It wouldn't be surprising if Apple switches to an even more powerful A19 or A20 chip.

Fourth: N1 wireless chip

The N1 wireless chip, first appearing in the iPhone 17, is also reportedly set to be used in the new Apple TV 4K.

With the N1, the Apple TV will support Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6, as well as Thread networking.

By comparison, the current Apple TV hardware, already four years old, only supports Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.

What features do you hope the new Apple TV 4K will have? Let us know in the comments.
